[h2]An absolute technical trainwreck that EA still has the audacity to charge hundreds of dollars for.[/h2]
Don't get me wrong — this game is a masterpiece and (maybe) even the peak of the entire franchise. Its open-world mechanic is legendary, the customization is unmatched, and it rightfully earned its iconic, cult-classic status. But today, making it work requires jumping through an endless series of technical hoops.

So, why skip buying this anywhere:
[list]
    [*]Lag festival: Runs like garbage even without any DLCs. With them? Enjoy your $400 slideshow.
    [*]Constant frame drops: Even on a high-end PC, the game stutters and drops FPS like crazy.
    [*]Modern CPU? Forget it: It straight up crashes on launch unless you manually mod the game's .exe file.
    [*]Task Manager gymnastics: If you don't patch it, your only other option is to speedrun Task Manager to change CPU affinity before the executable kills itself.
    [*]Config file nightmare: Get ready to dig into old .ini files and manually edit values just to make the game recognize a modern GPU.
    [*]Community-made life support: You are forced to download, install, and troubleshoot a dozen community mods just to fix core game bugs and memory leaks.
    [*]Insane pricing: $20 for a broken 2009 base game, plus another $380 for 19 overpriced DLCs.
[/list]
It’s literal abandonware. EA completely ghosted this game but still keeps their hands in your pockets. 
Do not buy. Save your money and acquire this classic through other, more reasonable means online.

For gameplay, it's got much, much more than TS4, plus this goes on steep sales often, it's abandoned though so you'll need to mod it to work on modern hardware, still worth it imo, 

 With some good lighting mods + default replacers for skin and eyes can somewhat modernize the graphics a lil bit. Not much can be done about the dated fashion though. 

 Compared to TS4 other than graphics and CAS, TS3 is far better with everything else other than the lack of multitasking that TS4 sims can do.

 Also TS3 goes on deep 50% sales often usually you can get all the dlcs and game for less than $200 whereas TS4 is over $2000 for everything.

Incredible game,  probably my personal favourite game, but sadly time has not been well to it, you need to properly set the game up to run well on modern machines and the game rarely goes on sale and all the expansions cost a lot! still i'd rather play this other the sims 4 anyday

Lack of support for modern PCs, so it crashes at random intervals, but it especially does when I zoom out or in really quickly. Those positive reviews? Most people are still using older/non-RTX rigs that are half my age (1992 baby). So the game functions fine for them

How I fixed mine?
I was able to get it working by popular community patches. Even so, disappointed at companies like Ubisoft and EA for setting such low/lazy standards (including Bethesda for Fallout 3 and 4).

It's a classic problem:
It's not that you need a beefy rig- it's the fact that the game isn't patched to recognize high core counts and newer GPUs (manually adding them every time I uninstall this, and sims 2, I have to do it all over again)

Once you've done the manual patching, I had FPS stuttering (that was there since the game's release), which was caused by the game having no functional Vsync, and it was running unlocked behind the scenes (regardless of your display). For nVidia, I opened its control panel and set the game's vsync to Fast and frames limited to 60 (thanks to online community)

Otherwise, why I recommend this game:

- It's open world, which devs shouldn't have stepped away from with Sims 4 because we know Consoles and PCs always keep improving with newer releases

- Because of open world, it's not just your lot that is active. The world you live in keeps moving.

- Travelling within the open world is fun, and no loading screens

- Adventures DLC is probably the most fun DLC of all the other DLCs

I LOVVVVVVVVEEEEEEE!! So addictive, literally played for like 12 hours straight (I am employed btw) I love the generations and supernatural pack, seasons is also really good but omg it rains soooooo much!! pls stop raining!!! I also purchased the ambitions pack, the ghost hunting job is such a cool addition even though my sim keeps getting kicked off the haunted lots for showering and eating in her cilents house lol, not my fault the hours are obtuse and needs need to be met! I know other users have had performance issues ruin their experience; however SOME can be fixed/ prevented. Before downloading I highly recommend (if you can) unsyncing onedrive, as this action will prevent file and save corruption. I cannot recommend enough watching Pixelades video on how to get the game running for windows 10/11 very informative and easy to follow. made me feel like a hacking beast.

One tiny little miniscule piece of constructive criticism, is that certain patterned wallpapers and clothing items are quite glitchy and blurry; not entirely the games fault as it is literally an ancient relic but oh well.  
Overall, this game is great fun, the base game feels so alive, even more so then sims 4 with all the expansion packs. Whilst the packs are half off though... TREAT YOURSELF!!! generations is so cute as you can give your elders little pimp walking canes.

If you can't launch the game, it may be due to your CPU's performance cores (P-cores) and efficiency cores (E-cores).
如果你打不開遊戲，可能是因為CPU的大小核造成的

Open Notepad and save the following script as a PowerShell file named sim3.ps1.
請用記事本將下列程式另存成為sim3.ps1的powershell檔


echo "Launch Sims 3..."

do{
$TS3 = Get-Process TS3, TS3W -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
}until($TS3)

$Affinity=$TS3.ProcessorAffinity

$TS3.ProcessorAffinity=1

Start-Sleep -s 5

$TS3.ProcessorAffinity=$Affinity


Before launching the game, right-click sim3.ps1 and select Run with PowerShell.
執行遊戲前，對sim3.ps1右鍵用powershell執行

Then start the game, and it should run normally.
接著執行遊戲，就可以正常遊玩了。

This game was made in 2009. I have a modern PC that can run any current gen game flawlessly.

you can ONLY play ONE expansion at a time anyway. then start over with a new family and play the next expansion. if you try to download them all at once, your game will break and your save file corrupted.

90% of the time you play, you can NOT log into your sims account., it's just broken and dead. so none of your accomplishments will ever register. you play solo, with no EA cloud. some weeks it wont even let me load my save files at all. sometimes my save file has just vanished.

One time after 100 hours into my first playthrough, some zombies came to my house, and would not let me sleep. so all my guy did was complain about being tired. pass out on the floor, wake up, complain, and immediately pass out again in and endless loop. My 100 hour game was completely broken.

If EA makes a game this broken and refuses to fix it ever, then I will never buy from EA again

Cyberpunk was notoriously broken too, but at least they fixed it. EA just doesn't care about you at all.
i love the sims 3. but dont even bother playing it on modern computers. my save just gets corrupted every time i play.

Don’t get unless you’re ready for constant problems. I bought the game knowing it was buggy but I had no idea that it was borderline unplayable. The game itself runs pretty smoothly, gameplay is fun and I’d even say it’s better than the sims 4, the problems occur when you need to save the game you’re playing. Almost every time I’ve played, I’ve had to start a new world. The game won’t save normally, you need to ‘save as’ and change the name to something you haven’t saved it as before.
Then you’ll be lucky to find your save on the menu screen. You have to start a new world, then add them there so you have to restart all of your progress.
If you are lucky enough to get them to show up in the menu, there’s a pretty high chance you’re game will load and you’ll get a notification that says “A serious error has occurred while loading [world], it is strongly recommended that you restart the application.

Restarting the application does absolutely nothing. If you look around online people will say to move the EA file but that also does nothing. Some people seem to not have the same problems but I guess it’s just something you have to consider before buying.
It sucks. I really enjoy the game and wanted to get more expansion packs but I’m so sick of starting over and over again.

I'll admit to having played a lot of 4 and purchased  a significant amount of dlc with the caveat it was on PS4 and with such poor optimization the amount of dlc made it unplayable, the only thing the Sims would do autonomously is drink water, I never really got over the burn from EA This entry has a lot of QoL features that and because of its age the modding scene is prolific. What really puts this game into a must have for me is the ease of play on my Xbox Ally X. This is my go to gaming platform right now and after tryin 4 and 2 Legacy Collection I was pessimistic that this game would be playable on a handheld pc but it is more than playable and while I cannot verify other handhelds I would imagine  Steam Deck and other SteamOS systems are configured to take full advantage of the platform. Only thing I really am not a fan of is you will see the beginning of the DLC nickel and dime Era where you must shell out cash for ridiculous items still being sold for thi game that has not had meaningful DLC in almost thirteen years and the shop is always trying to sell something everytime you go into purchase mode. I got the majority of DLC half off for Summerfest. so keep an eye out for sales. Cheers!
